name: fujita_conjecture

VINIT.justification: Initial state before any proof attempt or validation exists

TANCH.justification: Final containment of the conjecture as a resolved truth or falsehood in mathematical knowledge

AFWD.justification: Directed transformation assuming ampleness to derive absence of rational curves

AREV.justification: Reverse process seeking rational curves under ampleness to disprove the conjecture

CLINK.justification: Sequential composition of lemmas and logical implications in the proof

IMSCRIB.justification: Self-referential property defining ampleness equivalence to curve absence

FSPLIT.justification: Splits proof into cases based on rational curve presence or absence

FFUSE.justification: Reconstitutes the proof attempt by combining both case outcomes

EVALT.justification: Affirmative branch where no rational curve exists under ampleness

EVALF.justification: Negative branch where rational curve existence disproves the conjecture

ENGAGR.justification: Paradice state where neither proof nor disproof is possible under current axioms

IFIX.justification: Permanent record of the result in mathematical literature

phase_3.void_description: Conjecture as an open problem without proof or disproof
phase_3.true_description: Conjecture proven: ampleness implies no rational curves
phase_3.false_description: Conjecture disproven: counterexample with ample canonical bundle and rational curve
phase_3.both_description: Undecidable status where proof and disproof conditions coexist without resolution

steps.domain_action: Initialize the Fujita conjecture as an unproven statement
Define the self-referential equivalence between ampleness and rational curve absence
Begin proof attempt by assuming canonical bundle ampleness
Branch based on existence of rational curves in the variety
In no-curve branch, apply algebraic geometry deductions
Compose lemmas showing ampleness entails no rational curves
Validate success when deductions confirm conjecture
In curve-existence branch, initiate counterexample search
Compose steps demonstrating contradiction from rational curve presence
Reconcile both branches into complete proof verdict
Contain resolved conjecture as theorem or refuted statement
Publish result in permanent mathematical record

phase_5.compiler_frontend: Mathematician's intuition translating conjectures into formal operations
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Peer review and academic discourse validating intermediate steps
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Mathematical literature storing definitions and prior results
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Logical inference rules dictating deduction order
phase_5.alfs_store: Zermelo-Fraenkel set theory with Axiom of Choice foundations

phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Open conjecture with undefined truth value
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Resolved conjecture with fixed truth status
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — Truth revelation conserves information under axiomatic constraints
